Agent Name: Reviews_Expert
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: Provided unverified and incorrect “manual” data, including (1) claiming wheelchair accessibility for Mist Trail and Upper Yosemite Falls, which are not wheelchair accessible; (2) using AllTrails review counts and ratings for “Vernal and Nevada Falls via Mist Trail” instead of TripAdvisor, violating the requirement of >1,000 TripAdvisor reviews; and (3) asserting “at least three” wheelchair-accessibility recommendations without evidence or source verification. These errors led directly to an incorrect final solution.
